data:
The user wants to turn Wi-Fi on. Looking at the screenshot, I can see we're in the Settings app, specifically in the Internet section. I can see there's a Wi-Fi toggle switch that appears to be currently off (the toggle is on the left side/gray).

The Wi-Fi section shows:
- "Wi-Fi" text with a toggle switch
- The toggle appears to be in the off position (left side/gray)
- There's an "AndroidWifi" network listed as "Saved / No internet access"

To turn Wi-Fi on, I need to tap on the Wi-Fi toggle switch. Looking at the coordinates, the Wi-Fi toggle appears to be at approximately [846, 376, 960, 415] based on the layout.

Since the task is to turn Wi-Fi on and I can see the Wi-Fi toggle is currently off, I should tap on it to enable Wi-Fi.
do(action="Tap", element=[846,376,960,415])
